scope: Offline-only helper for materialising the already frozen router feature contract from target-free historical identities plus a schema-v2 forward candidate grid. It does not train, score, calibrate, admit, replay, perform exchange I/O, or alter live inference.

contracts.candidate_identity: candidate_id, UTC decision timestamp, side, native timestamp and symbol; exact identity is required after feature generation
contracts.causality: Target-free identity sources only; the forward grid must declare no future-path columns consumed. The feature engine uses causal hourly inputs only.
contracts.features: Explicit ordered frozen feature-contract JSON; no runtime feature discovery or target-derived selection.
contracts.missing_data: Values remain missing in output; no label-conditioned filtering, fill, or synthetic outcome-derived feature is permitted.

implementation.outputs: Immutable month-partitioned causal_feature_universe.parquet panels, per-field coverage, target-free identity/coverage audit, and run manifest.

validation_plan: target-free August grid manifest and per-month identity/coverage audit
strict router and downstream U/MC1 causality checks after forward scoring
